_meta.note: Per-technology parameter cards. Values carry evidence class (M,V,S,F,B,A) and source key. PNNL values are AC-AC at transformer level, USD 2021. [U] = unverified, check primary source.
_meta.pnnl: Viswanathan, Mongird, Franks, Li, Sprenkle, Baxter (2022) 2022 Grid Energy Storage Technology Cost and Performance Assessment, PNNL-33283

li_ion_lfp.status: dominant; all Finnish operating and pipeline BESS

auxiliary_kw_per_mwh.italy_source: Dimovski et al. 2026 Batteries 12:288 via secondary [U]

li_ion_lfp.degradation_notes: Calendar ageing ~62% of loss at first replacement; omitting it understates lifecycle cost ~35% (Butt & Li 2026). Separate low-temperature cycle ageing (plating) mechanism (Schimpe et al. 2018). CATL 'zero degradation 5 yr' = sacrificial Li5FeO4 additive delaying fade.
li_ion_lfp.cold_climate: Cell window ~10-30 C; heating needed in Finnish winter; cold lowers calendar ageing, raises plating risk if charged cold.

sodium_ion.status: early commercial; ~9 GWh shipped globally 2025 (V, secondary)

cost_parity_with_lfp.class: B (secondary, BNEF via Earth Energy Log)

sodium_ion.model_use: share of new BESS from 2030 as variant (0 / 10 / 30%); lower auxiliary kW/MWh (passive TMS) and lower cost tail

vanadium_flow.status: commercial at GWh scale in China; ~20 MWh max outside China
vanadium_flow.cycle_life: unlimited electrolyte; stacks 12 yr; project 24 yr (PNNL)

iron_air.status: first commercial systems Q4 2025 (Form Energy, V); ~80 GWh under agreement (V)

capex_target_usd_kwh.note: equals Sepulveda et al. 2021 threshold for >=10% system cost reduction

Kemijoki_Ailangantunturi.status: permits applied May 2026; construction >=2029; operation ~2033 subject to FID

hydrogen_p2p.role: outside storage boundary; competing flexibility; Fingrid vision 2040 H2 scenario ~5 GW electric-equivalent storage

thermal_sand.role: outside storage boundary; competing flexibility for low-price hours; may bid reserves

grid_forming.fingrid_storage_code: grid-forming required for large batteries (Merus Rovaniemi 30 MW / 80 MWh cited)

fingrid_weak_grid_vre_oct2026.conditions: type D wind/solar, ESCR<1.0, new connections; online at >=50% output; within 60 km

grid_forming.eu_rfg2: binding grid-forming for new storage >1 MW proposed (ENTSO-E phase II report, Nov 2025); national implementation pending
grid_forming.model_use: non-market co-located BESS component proportional to new weak-grid VRE
